printed ST. MICHAEL; from the east, ends at State (Storrs Congregational Church opposite)

printed GERMAN (east of State). West of State German's line runs on through the open junction to Warsaw/Elberon (the German water pipe turns into the Warsaw pipe at 5150,6990). German Street was probably renamed English Street in 1918

Warsaw (40') ends here and the same street line continues SSW as ELBERON AV. (about 60 ft), turning about 33 degrees; the point is where the two centrelines meet. It is also the west end of German's line across the open junction (Warsaw pipe turns east along German here). Warsaw and State only touch at the gore tip (5256,6898) and their centrelines never cross on the sheet, so no separate Warsaw/State pick

in the binding gutter at the right edge, beyond the page fold at x ~6380. The street is unnamed here; NEAVE from the key map (60' printed, two pipes, grade circle 90'). Neave's west face runs along the fold and its east face is off the paper; x is a compromise between the midpoint of its two pipes (~6500) and 30 ft east of the west face (~6560, foreshortened by the fold). German's faces stop at the fold. East leg not visible (key map shows German continuing east to W 6th). Lower precision than the others (paper curves into the binding), maybe +-30 px

continuation of the same hatched strip (probably public steps) from Warsaw's east face to State's west face

notes: No panels. Streets: Hill (40', printed HILL only) from the top edge to a dead end at y 2425; Price Hill Road (printed PRICE HILL R'D, 50') diagonally from top to bottom with no crossings on this sheet; Warsaw Av. (40') from the top edge to the junction at the bottom, where it becomes Elberon Av. and meets State Av. and German; State Av. (60') from the top edge down the right side, with Hatmaker, Staebler, Storrs and St. Michael ending at it from the east (462/459 block outlines) and German crossing it. The 462 and 459 blocks east of State are outlines from neighbouring sheets. West Eighth Street is just off the top edge. Neave Street is unnamed on this sheet and drawn only in the binding gutter beyond the fold; its crossings with St. Michael and Storrs are off the paper. The hatched strip at y ~2220-2280 across the blocks between Price Hill Road, Warsaw and State is recorded under alleys (unnamed, probably steps).
